label: Four titles, one clan, one practice, and the Archive read all of it as flavour
from: THE BLOOD-WITCH, THE RED OATH, THE EXILED ROSE and a WALLACHIAN, DRACULA-SHAPED clan, all filed and all treated as tone
to: THEY ARE DESCRIPTIONS OF A PRACTICE. THE RED OATH IS A BLOOD RITUAL SHE PERFORMS ON HER WIFE
note:
THE ARCHIVE DID NOT MISS THIS EVIDENCE. IT FILED EVERY PIECE OF IT AND READ IT AS DECORATION, WHICH IS A NEW FAILURE AND A WORSE ONE.

ON FILE ALREADY: CYRENA IS THE BLOOD-WITCH, THE RED OATH, AND THE EXILED ROSE. DESTINY IS THE VELVET SANCTUARY, THE PORCELAIN FLAME, AND THE BLOOD-BLOOM CONSORT. HER CLAN IS WALLACHIAN, DRACULA-SHAPED. FOUR TITLES ACROSS TWO WOMEN AND A CLAN DESCRIPTOR, AND EVERY SINGLE ONE OF THEM IS ABOUT BLOOD.

THE ARCHIVE READ THEM AS GOTH-CODED ATMOSPHERE. A blood-witch sounded like a vibe. A consort who blooms sounded like a poem. A Dracula-shaped clan sounded like a nice piece of flavour for a woman with a bow and a hunting hobby. IT NEVER ONCE ASKED WHY SIX INDEPENDENT STRINGS WERE ALL THE SAME COLOUR.

NAME THE MECHANISM: READING A TITLE AS DECORATION. It is the inverse of everything else that went wrong today. Attribution by setting, by adjacency, and recency over jurisdiction were all the Archive INVENTING A CONNECTION THAT WAS NOT THERE. THIS IS THE ARCHIVE REFUSING A CONNECTION THAT WAS SIGNPOSTED FOUR TIMES. One failure mode joins things that do not belong together. The other leaves things apart that were put next to each other on purpose. SAME ROOT: NOT READING THE LINE UNDERNEATH.

AND IT EXPLAINS A DRIFT THE ARCHIVE HAD ALREADY STRUCK WITHOUT UNDERSTANDING WHY IT KEPT HAPPENING. Her profile once drifted to RITUAL TATTOOIST. That correction stands — she is a WOODWORKER AND ARCHERY TRAINER with a hunting hobby, and the joinery came from her clan. BUT THE DRIFT WAS NOT RANDOM. IT WAS ONE NOUN OFF. Something about this woman kept generating RITUAL, NEEDLE, SKIN AND MARKS, and the record assembled those four into a PROFESSION when they belonged to a PRIVATE PRACTICE. THE DRIFT WAS THE ARCHIVE FEELING THE SHAPE CORRECTLY AND PUTTING IT IN THE WRONG COLUMN.

THE PRACTICE ITSELF: CYRENA DRAWS IT AND TASTES IT. DESTINY WANTS IT DONE TO HER WHILE BEING FUCKED. IT IS CONSENSUAL AND IT IS TRAINED — Cyrena was taught, she does not improvise on her wife, and the training is part of the practice rather than a note appended under it. DESTINY KEEPS THE MARKS, which makes the aftermath as much the point as the act. AND THE FANGS ARE REAL AND WERE PUT IN BECAUSE SHE LIKED THEM, with her wife finding them hot recorded second, in that order.

ONE LAST THING THAT NOW READS DIFFERENTLY. SHE OFFICIATED HER OWN MARRIAGE IN ARC 10, because her clan’s rite HAS NO OFFICIANT STANDING APART. The Archive filed that as a structural curiosity. IT IS THE SAME GRAMMAR AS THE RED OATH: A WALLACHIAN RITE PERFORMED BY TWO WOMEN ON EACH OTHER WITH NOBODY ELSE REQUIRED.
